newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends higher, cent bank sells dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends higher, cent bank sells dlrs.

text.p: The Philippine peso ended higher on Monday, helped by some dollar inflows and the central bank's sales of dollars, traders said.
"The central bank was selling down to 28.45 to influence the rate," a trader said.
The central bank may have accounted for 20 to 30 percent of the market volume of $39.7 million, traders estimate.
The peso settled at 28.60 to dollar from the previous close of 28.99.
Traders said the central bank still had to sell dollars to satisfy import requirements.
